headline: Council recesses meeting after roll call, citing severe weather

meeting.body: Maui County Council Meeting - recessed to 9/29/2026 @ 9
meeting.summary: The chair paused the session after the clerk took roll and said it will reconvene at 9 a.m. on the same Teams link. The chair also announced a meet and greet with a Fukuyama City Council delegation at the council chamber.
meeting.recap: The chair called the council meeting of September 25th, 2026 to order.[[0:00:00]] Because of severe weather, the chair said the meeting would be recessed (paused) right after the clerk took roll.[[0:00:21]] The chair said the meeting would reconvene at 9 a.m. Tuesday, September 29th, at the same Teams link posted for that day's agenda.[[0:00:29]] All members joined online and were asked to say who, other than minors, was with them during roll call.[[0:00:46]] The vice chair was excused.[[0:02:58]] The clerk reported eight members present and one excused, which is a quorum (enough members to conduct business).[[0:03:18]] The chair shared a staff announcement that a delegation from the Fukuyama City Council will visit for a meet and greet on Wednesday, September 30th.[[0:03:27]] The meet and greet is set for 4 to 5 p.m. at the council chamber.[[0:03:42]] The chair invited all council members who are available to join.[[0:03:45]] The chair put the meeting in recess.[[0:04:02]]
meeting.next: The council will reconvene this meeting at the same Teams meeting link.

moments.q: "Given the severe weather, after the clerk takes roll"
Quorum reported: eight present, one excused
"So this meeting is now in recess."
